definitions.REPM: Rare Earth Permanent Magnet — NdFeB/SmCo magnets for EV traction motors, wind generators, and defense guidance systems.
definitions.NdFeB: Neodymium-Iron-Boron; strongest commercial permanent magnet alloy.
definitions.SmCo: Samarium-Cobalt; high-temperature rare earth magnet for aerospace and defense motors.
definitions.hard ferrites: Sintered ferrite magnets for automotive magnetos and small motors.
definitions.flywheel magneto: Magneto ignition with stator/rotor magnet stack.
definitions.traction motors: EV/rail propulsion motor — primary REPM demand driver.
definitions.BLDC motors: Brushless DC motors using permanent-magnet rotors.
definitions.heavy mineral sand: Beach-sand feedstock for monazite/rutile rare earth corridor.
definitions.monazite: Mineral sand with rare earth phosphates; IREL/NLC feedstock.
definitions.magnet winding wires: Enamelled copper for motor windings — magnet/motor supply chain.
definitions.REPM scheme: ₹7,280 crore PLI for ~6,000 MTPA domestic REPM capacity.
